title: Direct Go ResourceSearchRequest constructions must request FIELD_VALUES
answers: How should I build a ResourceSearchRequest in Go?
Why did CI fail on my new ResourceSearchRequest code?
What result format should new search request clients use?
body: Any new Go code that directly constructs a resourcepb.ResourceSearchRequest (composite literal, new(...), or a `var request resourcepb.ResourceSearchRequest` declaration, including inside a grouped `var (...)` block) must set `ResultFormat: resourcepb.ResourceSearchRequest_FIELD_VALUES` and decode the response's actual ResultFormat for mixed-version compatibility. This is enforced only for files/lines changed relative to the PR base, so pre-existing non-FIELD_VALUES usages are grandfathered. If a different format is required for compatibility, suppress the rule at the allocation site with an inline reason comment rather than removing the check.
applies: Go code in the grafana/grafana repo that builds resourcepb.ResourceSearchRequest, outside pkg/storage/unified/resourcepb and pkg/storage/unified/testing
